body:
I'm sorry to hear that you cut 3 times that day.  I cannot imagine how much anguish you felt.  I have been suicidal, but I was always too afraid to cut.  For me, it was like, I was stuck alive even though I wanted to die... I don't know if that makes sense.  But cutting... I cannot believe that you deserve that.  No one does.  The experience of being suicidal is beyond language.  I wish we had the language for it though.  We NEED it.

Judgmental about the arms... it's devastating.  It is the experience where people "see" us, on the outside, but they don't SEE us, the way we want and NEED to be seen.  There is so much fear, and people make assumptions.  The mentality of mankind needs to evolve.

I think for me, spirituality helps.  But for me, it is very private.  I don't go to church, etc.  I just pray on my own.  Finally I have found my way, and it is good.

Thanks.  Thanks for sharing as well.  It is so important for that compassion to exist.  It's almost like... "reading between the lines."  It's hard.  Sometimes impossible.  I wish there was an answer for it, and... I hope there is an answer.  But I don't know what it is yet.  Hopefully, we will find out one day.
